Name: retro ducks
Author: 35friedshrimp
Description:
the mod you never asked for, but got anyways! it replaces your ducks with the little dudes from space invaders.

[b]how to install[/b]
(remember to make a backup of the original file beforehand)
[list]
[*]unzip "retro ducks"
[*]place in content/animals
[/list]or
[list]
[*]install smapi & content patcher
[*]place in stardewvalley/mods 
[/list]
[b]possible updates[/b]
[list]
[*]adding more retro game themed coop animals (think old mario, pac-man etc.)
[*]adding arcade noises instead of quacks (is this possible?)
[/list]
